svg.title: ai-kit high-level crate architecture
svg.desc: app-kit composes caller-built agents-kit implementations and separate application StateStore storage. agents-kit uses StateStore for its own durable state and an optional Database for managed knowledge. Its Custom implementation uses providers-kit for model calls and tools-kit for local and MCP tools. Native Codex and OpenCode runtimes have their own provider integration.
